svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
svg.text: The bottleneck holds parameters, not a code
z = mu + sigma * eps, eps ~ N(0, I)
The bottleneck holds no code: it holds the PARAMETERS (mu, sigma) of a distribution, and z is one draw from it.
Generation is the same decoder with the encoder deleted and the prior N(0, I) plugged in where q(z|x) sat.
